title: ci: prune the build-core, typecheck and pack-smoke Turbo seeds before saving them
body:
Fixes #26957
Part of #25452 (step 2 of its directive, rewritten by ruling 6458731814 to "prune, not drop"; step 3, the pool reading after at least 5 merges, stays open there)

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:把剩下四处 per-sha Turbo 种子(Build Core、Type Check · workspace、两个 pack-smoke 作业)的保存步骤接到现成的 `prune-turbo-cache.mjs` 后面,种子只留本次运行用到的任务条目;不删种子、不加脚本、不加门禁、不抬池子上限。
- 为什么改:裁决 6458731814 选 A「修剪,不删」;#26070 → A 后这些种子是 PR 构建唯一的缓存,但整份保存会把旧种子一路累积进去,挤爆 10 GB 缓存池。
- 风险与回滚:只动 `.github/workflows/` 的四个文件;最坏情况是某次 push 不保存种子(无运行摘要即 `save=false`),下一个 PR 退回上一份种子;回滚 = revert 本 PR。
- 先看:`.github/workflows/lint.yml`(typecheck 两条 turbo 命令加 `--summarize`,否则修剪会丢掉 typecheck 条目);`.github/workflows/publish-smoke.yml`(`actions/cache` 拆成 restore + save,保存门槛与原 post-step 一致);`.github/workflows/ci.yml` Build Core 尾部。
- 两分钟验证:`node scripts/ci/prune-turbo-cache.mjs --self-test`,预期最后一行 `prune-turbo-cache self-test: OK (25 case(s) across 5 batteries).`
- 需要你做的:作为 GOVERNED_APPROVERS 审批(或亲手合并)这个 Tier H draft PR。

## What changes

Ruling 6458731814, verbatim from #26957: "Letter **A, prune, do not drop**: the Build Core, Type Check · workspace and pack-smoke per-sha seeds stay, and each seed-save step is wired behind `scripts/ci/prune-turbo-cache.mjs --site …` exactly as Test Core, Build UI Deps, Type Check UI and Lint UI are today, so a seed holds only the task entries its own run used." and "⛔ The pool limit is not raised here" stands.

Every save site of the three seed families, derived from the YAML at `origin/main` `cb8988ee14` (each `actions/cache*` step whose key resolves to `turbo-build-core-`, `turbo-typecheck-` or `turbo-pack-smoke-`):

| Site (job) | File | Saves when (unchanged) | Turbo run had `--summarize`? | Change |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Build Core (`build-core`) | `ci.yml` | `always() && push` | yes (`pnpm build --summarize`, summary left in `.turbo/runs/`) | prune step `--site 'Build Core'`; save ANDs `save == 'true'` |
| Type Check · workspace (`typecheck-workspace`), the one designated typecheck writer | `lint.yml` | `always() && push` | build yes; `turbo run typecheck` NO | `--summarize` added to both `turbo run typecheck` lines; prune step `--site 'Type Check · workspace'`; save ANDs `save == 'true'` |
| Packed-tarball smoke, release candidate (`pack-smoke`) | `publish-smoke.yml` | every run it runs on (`workflow_run` after Release, `workflow_dispatch`), job green, exact key missed (the `actions/cache` post-step) | NO (`pnpm run build`) | `--summarize` added; `actions/cache` split into `actions/cache/restore` + `actions/cache/save` behind the prune, same gate: `success() && cache-hit != 'true' && save == 'true'` |
| Packed-tarball smoke, opt-in (`pack-smoke`) | `pack-smoke-optin.yml` | `pull_request` with `needs:pack-smoke`, job green, exact key missed | NO | same as the row above |

Restore-only sites, untouched: `ci.yml` `ui-published-artifacts`; `lint.yml` `typecheck-source-gates`, `typecheck-debt`, `typecheck-consumers`; `test-nightly-tiers.yml` `tiers` (L186 is a restore, not a save, so no wiring is owed there). The pack-smoke seed is keyed `${{ runner.os }}-turbo-${{ github.job }}-${{ github.sha }}`, which is why a grep for the literal `turbo-pack-smoke` finds nothing.

Wiring notes:

- `--summarize` does not enter a task hash (ci.yml Build Core's ASSERTED paragraph: 83 of 83 identical with and without, turbo 2.11.5), and none of the four TURBO_* remote-cache lines is added anywhere, so the PINS in that comment still hold.
- The pack-smoke save keeps `continue-on-error: true` and keeps the post-step's semantics: a failed `actions/cache` post-step never failed the job, and an explicit save step without the flag could have.
- The two pack-smoke prune steps also carry `cache-hit != 'true'`, so an exact-key hit, which the post-step never saved, does not touch the restored cache either.
- No `--site` list is pinned anywhere: `git grep -n "prune-turbo-cache" -- scripts packages .github` hits only the script itself and `ci.yml` (its CI-filter path and its `--self-test` in Build Core), and the script's self-test uses the fixture site name only.

## Tests

- `node scripts/ci/prune-turbo-cache.mjs --self-test` (script unchanged): `prune-turbo-cache self-test: OK (25 case(s) across 5 batteries).`, exit 0.
- End-to-end on a real turbo run, private `--cache-dir` so the shared cache was untouched: a planted stale entry `deadbeef` plus `pnpm exec turbo run typecheck --filter=@objectstack/sdui-parser --summarize`, then the exact prune command of the `lint.yml` site. Output: `kept 1 task entry named by 1 run summary` / `dropped 3 file(s) the run did not use`, `save=true`; what is left is the typecheck task's three files only. That shows the `--summarize` this PR adds is what keeps the typecheck entries.
- `pnpm run build --summarize --dry=json` echoes `turbo run build --filter=!@objectstack/docs --filter=!./ui*/apps/site --summarize --dry=json`, so pnpm forwards the flag to turbo in the two pack-smoke jobs.
- YAML parsed with PyYAML; every changed step rendered (`if:`, key, command):

<details><summary>Rendered steps</summary>

```
ci.yml build-core | Prune the Turbo cache to this run's tasks (main only) | id=prune-turbo-cache | if="always() && github.event_name == 'push'" | --site 'Build Core'
ci.yml build-core | Save Turbo cache (main only) | if="always() && github.event_name == 'push' && steps.prune-turbo-cache.outputs.save == 'true'" | key=${{ runner.os }}-turbo-${{ github.job }}-${{ github.ref_name }}-${{ github.sha }}
lint.yml typecheck-workspace | Type check workspace packages | 'pnpm exec turbo run typecheck "${UNIVERSE[@]}" --summarize', 'pnpm exec turbo run typecheck "${FILTERS[@]}" --summarize'
lint.yml typecheck-workspace | Prune the Turbo cache to this run's tasks (main only) | id=prune-turbo-cache | if="always() && github.event_name == 'push'" | --site 'Type Check · workspace'
lint.yml typecheck-workspace | Save Turbo cache (main only) | if="always() && github.event_name == 'push' && steps.prune-turbo-cache.outputs.save == 'true'" | key=${{ runner.os }}-turbo-typecheck-${{ github.ref_name }}-${{ github.sha }}
publish-smoke.yml pack-smoke | Setup turbo cache | uses=actions/cache/restore@v6 | id=turbo-cache | key=${{ runner.os }}-turbo-${{ github.job }}-${{ github.sha }}
publish-smoke.yml pack-smoke | Build | pnpm run build --summarize
publish-smoke.yml pack-smoke | Prune the Turbo cache to this run's tasks | id=prune-turbo-cache | if="success() && steps.turbo-cache.outputs.cache-hit != 'true'" | --site 'Packed-tarball smoke (release candidate)'
publish-smoke.yml pack-smoke | Save turbo cache | if="success() && steps.turbo-cache.outputs.cache-hit != 'true' && steps.prune-turbo-cache.outputs.save == 'true'" | key=${{ runner.os }}-turbo-${{ github.job }}-${{ github.sha }}
pack-smoke-optin.yml pack-smoke | Setup turbo cache | uses=actions/cache/restore@v6 | id=turbo-cache | key=${{ runner.os }}-turbo-${{ github.job }}-${{ github.sha }}
pack-smoke-optin.yml pack-smoke | Build | pnpm run build --summarize
pack-smoke-optin.yml pack-smoke | Prune the Turbo cache to this run's tasks | id=prune-turbo-cache | if="success() && steps.turbo-cache.outputs.cache-hit != 'true'" | --site 'Packed-tarball smoke (opt-in)'
pack-smoke-optin.yml pack-smoke | Save turbo cache | if="success() && steps.turbo-cache.outputs.cache-hit != 'true' && steps.prune-turbo-cache.outputs.save == 'true'" | key=${{ runner.os }}-turbo-${{ github.job }}-${{ github.sha }}
```

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- Post-prune seed size: **NOT MEASURED: seed size, reason: only a push run on `main` saves these seeds, so the first reading is the first push run after this lands.** Read the `prune-turbo-cache: Build Core: …` and `prune-turbo-cache: Type Check · workspace: …` lines (`kept N task entries …` / `dropped N file(s) the run did not use: X MB -> Y MB on disk.`) in that run's Build Core and Type Check · workspace logs. The pack-smoke lines (`prune-turbo-cache: Packed-tarball smoke (…): …`) appear on the next Release-triggered Publish Smoke run, or on a PR carrying `needs:pack-smoke`. The MB-scale figure on the card is an extrapolation from Test Core, not a measurement.
- Pool reading (#25452 step 3) is not this PR's: it needs at least 5 merges and `actions/cache/*` read access.
- Seen, not changed: both pack-smoke restores keep their bare `${{ runner.os }}-turbo-` restore-key fallback, which can restore any Turbo seed family. Wiring only; noted, not filed.

## Verification

Every other derived family exited 0, among them `check:self-test-wired`, `check:self-test-workflow-commands`, `check:ci-filter-parity`, `check:workflow-status-functions`, `check:workflow-step-name-quoting`, `check:step-collectors`, `check:shard-attestation` and `check:required-contexts`.

Governed surface: `.github/workflows/**`, Tier H. This lands only through a GOVERNED_APPROVERS approval or the maintainer's hand.
